logic_projects.title: Transmission Packet System
logic_projects.description: Standardized XML format for preserving AI session context and behavioral calibration across model boundaries - like TCP sequence numbers for AI conversations
key_features: Header with session metadata and challenge phrases
BehaviorProfile with quantifiable metrics (sycophancy_level, critical_thinking, technical_depth, pushback_threshold)
Body with summary, content, transcript, and artifacts
PacketLoopClosure with instructionsForNextModel
IntegrityChain with hash-chain validation
Preserves communication style and technical context across AI boundaries
logic_projects.outcomes: Maintains state continuity in stateless AI systems, preserving expert-level discussion and calibrated response styles across model transitions

logic_projects.title: Cybersecurity Agent Swarm
logic_projects.description: Comprehensive multi-agent swarm architecture for automated offensive and defensive cybersecurity operations
technologies: Nmap, Masscan, Metasploit, Suricata, Zeek, ELK Stack

architecture.orchestrator: Central Command & Control - 'Logic Pipe' for task assignment and event correlation
architecture.shared_knowledge_base: Collective memory enabling contextual awareness and historical analysis
red_team_agents: Discovery Agent (network scan, port scan, service enumeration)
Vulnerability Scanner (vuln scan, config audit, webapp scan)
Strategy Adaptation Agent (adapt attack strategy, re-evaluate targets)
blue_team_agents: Log Analysis Agent (log collection, parsing, anomaly detection)

logic_flows: Red Discovers → Blue Reacts (vulnerability found triggers patch management)
Blue Detects → Red Adapts (intrusion detected triggers strategy adaptation)
Blue Defends → Red Re-evaluates (defense action triggers target re-evaluation)
security_features: Rule engine with ML-driven decision making
logic_projects.outcomes: Adaptive, collaborative security testing system simulating realistic attack-defense scenarios with continuous learning
